brief:
Israel's election on October 27 approaches with uncertainty over the outcome, according to political analyst Dahlia Scheindlin. Scheindlin, based in Tel Aviv, argues that only a clear opposition victory would enable the country to heal after three difficult years and restore democratic strength.

The analyst frames an opposition win as necessary to establish Palestinian rights alongside democratic renewal in Israel. She emphasizes the need for fundamental reconsideration of national direction ahead of the vote.
dek: Only a clear opposition victory would let us begin to heal, strengthen democracy and establish Palestinian rights Dahlia Scheindlin is a Tel Aviv-based political analyst Israel’s 27 October election is fast approaching, with little clarity about who will win.
title: Israeli analyst calls for opposition victory to reset democracy
